records.title: Principal rays and conjunction terminology

source_statement.conjunction: same sign, degree and minute; coition, synod, congress

qualifications_and_limits: Lilly calls conjunction an aspect improperly and refers to other new aspects mentioned earlier; this is not a whole-book absence claim.

records.title: Reconciliation and the two adverse aspects
records.source_statement: Square signifies imperfect enmity: reconciliation remains possible with assistance from the other significators. Opposition signifies perfect hatred: no peace expected before the suit ends or the challenge has been fought.
prerequisites: Question about reconciling two adversaries; the planets are their main significators.
qualifications_and_limits: Do not infer innate character or relationship safety from an arbitrary natal square/opposition. Later reception/perfection qualifications are retained separately.

records.title: Favourable aspects and conjunction polarity
records.source_statement: Sextile and trine argue love, unity and friendship, trine more forcibly; conjunctions are good or bad according to friendship/enmity of the planets.
prerequisites: Relevant significators in the enquiry.
qualifications_and_limits: No numerical force ratio or independent-evidence multiplier is supplied.

records.title: Partile definition and examples

source_statement.definition: exact separation corresponding to the aspect
source_statement.interpretation: Near completion when signifying good; equally present evil when mischief is threatened.

qualifications_and_limits: Degree-based examples do not specify a universal one-degree orb or settle all minute/second tolerances.

records.title: Platick rays use both planets moieties

source_statement.definition: Within the half-sum of the two planets' orbs
source_statement.example: Venus Taurus 10 and Saturn Virgo 18: eight degrees from trine; moieties four plus five give nine.

prerequisites: The planets signify the matter.
qualifications_and_limits: Two orb columns are printed; select a declared profile, never retrospectively whichever fits.

records.title: Application with both direct
records.source_statement: The swifter planet applies to the slower/ponderous one: Mercury Aries 5 to Mars Aries 10.
prerequisites: Both direct; appropriate relative motion.
qualifications_and_limits: Positions alone do not prove the future order of encounters.

records.title: Application with both retrograde
records.source_statement: Mercury Aries 10 to Mars Aries 9, Mercury remaining retrograde through conjunction, is an ill application associated with sudden perfection OR breaking off according to their signification.
prerequisites: Both retrograde and conjunction reached before Mercury turns direct.
qualifications_and_limits: Do not turn ill application into an unconditional non-occurrence prediction.

records.title: Mixed-motion application
records.source_statement: Direct Mars Aries 15 to retrograde Mercury Aries 17: ill application, great atmospheric change or sudden alteration in a question.
prerequisites: Direct planet lower, retrograde planet higher.
qualifications_and_limits: Weather and question outcomes are different reference frames; no exact forecast from these illustrative coordinates.

records.title: Application and weight hierarchy
records.source_statement: Lighter planets apply to more ponderous ones; superior planets do not apply to inferior ones unless retrograde. Saturn Aries 10 receives applications from Mars at degree 7 of Aries, Gemini, Cancer, Leo or Libra by conjunction, sextile, square, trine or opposition respectively.
qualifications_and_limits: Exact contact described at matching degree and minute; a complete event calculation requires both trajectories.

records.title: Dexter and sinister rays
records.source_statement: Sinister rays follow sign succession; dexter run against succession and are described as more forcible.
qualifications_and_limits: The direction belongs to the ray-casting source planet. No multiplier is specified.

records.title: Initial versus full separation

source_statement.initial_example: Saturn and Jupiter Aries 10:25; Jupiter at 10:31 or 10:32 is separating.
full_clearance_examples: Saturn 9-degree orb and Jupiter 9-degree orb: total clearance nine degrees.
Sun 15 and Moon 12: clearance thirteen degrees thirty minutes.

qualifications_and_limits: A six-minute initial departure and full moiety clearance are different predicates. These examples use the alternative orb column.

records.title: Separation timing in a marriage question
records.source_statement: Recently separated significators suggest a recent chance of marriage now suspended by dislike or rupture. Greater separation accompanies alienation; degrees left to full clearance supply a count of weeks, days, months or years.
prerequisites: The two planets are the marriage significators at the question time.
qualifications_and_limits: Unit choice is not specified by this passage. A precise date cannot be obtained by choosing units after seeing an event.

records.title: Separation timing modifiers
records.source_statement: Both significators in moveable signs, angular and swift hasten the time; common signs require longer, fixed signs longer still.
qualifications_and_limits: Keep the joint conditions; mixed modalities and absolute duration multipliers are unspecified.

records.title: Prohibition
records.source_statement: Before two applying principals perfect their aspect, a third planet interposes body or aspect, hindering and retarding the matter.
prerequisites: Principals signify completion of the question.
Intervention occurs before perfection.
qualifications_and_limits: Hindering/retarding is not automatically permanent impossibility.

records.title: Bodily prohibition example
records.source_statement: Mars Aries 7, Saturn Aries 12, Sun Aries 6: the faster Sun reaches Mars and then Saturn before Mars reaches Saturn.
prerequisites: Asserted encounter order, not just a static three-planet arrangement.
qualifications_and_limits: The statement that combustion is the greatest misfortune belongs to this explanatory passage.

records.title: Aspect prohibition example
records.source_statement: Mars Aries 7, Saturn Aries 15, Sun Gemini 5: the faster Sun reaches dexter sextiles to Mars and Saturn before the principal conjunction; analogous square, trine or opposition intervention.
qualifications_and_limits: No numerical speeds are provided. Do not manufacture precise time differences.

records.title: Refranation
records.source_statement: Mars Aries 7 approaches Saturn Aries 12 but turns retrograde before reaching degree 10 or 11; Saturn continues direct, and the promised conjunction is not effected.
qualifications_and_limits: Reversal before the promised encounter, not mere slowness.

records.title: Translation, introductory definition
records.source_statement: A light planet separates from a weightier planet and presently joins another weightier one, bodily or by aspect. Mercury Aries 16 takes Mars Aries 15 toward Saturn Aries 20.
prerequisites: Intermediary is the appropriate lighter carrier.
qualifications_and_limits: XXI adds explicit reception and no-intervening-contact conditions for its perfection route; retain both scopes.

records.title: Translation, represented means
records.source_statement: The person represented by the translating planet procures the assistance represented by the source planet for the receiving matter; useful in marriage, lawsuits and ordinary questions.
qualifications_and_limits: Subject is question-specific mediation, not a generic personality trait.

records.title: Mutual reception and examples

source_statement.definition: Two relevant planets in each other's essential dignities; by domicile is strongest.
examples: Sun Aries and Mars Leo: domicile.
Venus Aries and Sun Taurus: triplicity if by day.
Venus Aries numbered degree 24 and Mars Gemini numbered degree 16: terms.

prerequisites: Planets are significators in the matter.
qualifications_and_limits: Can involve triplicity, term, face or another essential dignity. Direction and day/night conditions must be preserved.

records.title: Reception despite adverse or missing aspect
records.source_statement: Mutual reception of the principal significators can bring the thing to pass suddenly and without great trouble to both parties, despite no aspect, denial by aspects or doubtful square/opposition testimony.
qualifications_and_limits: Retain beside XXI's much more qualified and often regrettable opposition-perfection description; do not erase the tension.

records.title: Peregrine definition and examples
records.source_statement: No essential dignity in the occupied sign degree. Saturn at Aries 10 is peregrine, but at 27/28 etc. is in its term and not peregrine. The Sun in Cancer has no dignity throughout that sign.
qualifications_and_limits: Fall and peregrinity need not be mutually exclusive. Reception versus own-dignity treatment remains separate.

records.title: Peregrine theft heuristic
records.source_statement: An angular or second-house peregrine planet very often signifies the thief.
prerequisites: A theft question.
qualifications_and_limits: Historical heuristic; do not infer criminality in a person from natal placement.

records.title: Void of course
records.source_statement: A planet has separated from a planet and does not forthwith, while it remains in that sign, apply to another; most commonly observed for the Moon. Business seldom proceeds handsomely.
qualifications_and_limits: Apply is not silently replaced by perfect an exact contact. Later strong-significator and sign exceptions are separately retained.

records.title: Frustration
records.source_statement: A swift planet would join a heavier one, but that heavier planet joins a third first: Mercury Aries 10, Mars 12, Jupiter 13, with Mars meeting Jupiter before Mercury reaches Mars.
qualifications_and_limits: Which encounter comes first requires trajectories or an explicitly supplied event ordering.

records.title: Hayz as actually printed

source_statement.day_branch: masculine diurnal planet by day above the earth in a masculine sign
source_statement.night_branch: feminine nocturnal planet by night UNDER the earth in a feminine sign
source_statement.use: querent content at question time when the significator so qualifies

qualifications_and_limits: The nocturnal below-earth wording was checked on the image and is not replaced with another school's above-earth convention.

records.title: Superior and inferior planets
qualifications_and_limits: Historical cosmological classification, not a modern physical distance ranking.

records.title: Combustion definition and contradictory example

source_statement.condition: same sign as Sun, no more than eight degrees thirty minutes either side in the stated definition
examples: Jupiter Aries 10, Sun Aries 18: eight degrees, called combust.
Jupiter Aries 28, Sun Aries 18: ten degrees, also called combust in print.
source_statement.restriction: bodily conjunction in one sign, not sextile/square/trine/opposition; Sun cannot itself be combust

qualifications_and_limits: Second example conflicts with the threshold, confirmed on image. Do not alter 28 to 26 or expand threshold silently. Exact threshold boundary and cazimi precedence remain explicit conventions.

records.title: Combustion direction, moiety and represented state
records.source_statement: The Sun hastening toward a conjunction afflicts more than receding; Lilly uses the Sun's moiety, not Jupiter's (the latter would be four degrees thirty). He acknowledges disagreement and asks the reader to use what proves truest. Combust querent significator denotes fear and being overpowered by a great person.
qualifications_and_limits: Author-endorsed development selection is not untouched validation; no retrospective orb shopping.

records.title: Under the beams and cazimi

source_statement.beams: until fully seventeen degrees from the Sun either side
source_statement.cazimi: within seventeen minutes forward or backward; fortified
source_statement.example: Sun Taurus 15:30 and Mercury Taurus 15:25: five minutes

qualifications_and_limits: Same-sign requirement is explicit for combustion, not independently restated for beams. Boundary and overlap policies are not a ready-made signed outcome score.

records.title: Orientality of superior planets
records.source_statement: Saturn, Jupiter and Mars are oriental from conjunction to opposition and occidental from opposition to conjunction; oriental rises before the Sun, occidental is visible above the horizon or sets after sunset.
qualifications_and_limits: A longitude proxy is not automatically a full observed-visibility calculation.

records.title: Orientality and elongation of Mercury and Venus
records.source_statement: Oriental when in fewer degrees of the Sun's sign or its preceding sign, occidental when in more degrees or the next sign. Stated maximum elongations are Mercury 28 degrees, Venus 48, with some allowing a few more; no sextile/square/trine/opposition to Sun.
qualifications_and_limits: These are source bounds, not newly verified Swiss Ephemeris results.

records.title: Moon oriental versus occidental
records.source_statement: Oriental from opposition to conjunction, occidental from conjunction to opposition, explained by the Moon's greater speed.
qualifications_and_limits: Increasing light and occidental are alternative descriptions of one table condition, not two score increments.

records.title: Bodily besieging
records.source_statement: A planet between the bodies of Saturn and Mars: Saturn Aries 15, Mars Aries 10, Venus Aries 13. The adverse represented condition requires Venus to be significatrix in that figure.
qualifications_and_limits: The image reads Aries, not the Capricorn inferred by the text layer. This local definition is bodily, unlike the broader Rhetorius aspect-pattern definition.

records.title: Selection of ancient accidents
records.source_statement: Lilly says he omits other accidents described by the ancients because he regards them as of little purpose in judgement.
qualifications_and_limits: This does not identify a complete excluded list or empirically prove the excluded techniques useless.

records.title: Direct, retrograde and stationary

source_statement.stationary: moves not at all; superior planets said to do so two, three or four days before retrogradation

qualifications_and_limits: An approximate historical stationary interval is not an astronomical exact-zero-speed plateau.

records.title: Degree sex as a conditional tiebreaker
records.source_statement: When angles, planet sex and signs leave equal testimony in the question, inspect the Moon, relevant significator and relevant house cusp in masculine/feminine degrees to poise judgement.
prerequisites: The preceding testimony is tied.
qualifications_and_limits: Examples concern fetal sex or sex of a thief; historical claims, not modern identification tools. Do not use as an unrestricted rescue after an observed failure.

records.title: Light and dark degrees
records.source_statement: Light rising degrees describe a fairer appearance; dark degrees an obscurer complexion. Conditional upon already being deformed, dark increases and light moderates the imperfection.
prerequisites: Relevant ascendant in a nativity or question.
qualifications_and_limits: Appearance and impairment assertions are historical; no modern diagnostic inference.

records.title: Void and smoky degrees
records.source_statement: Moon OR Ascendant in void degrees describes small understanding regardless of appearance; smoky degrees describe mixed complexion, stature and condition, neither extreme.
qualifications_and_limits: Void degrees are not void-of-course motion. Historical judgement of intellect is not validated measurement.

records.title: Aries light-degree worked reading
records.source_statement: First three degrees dark, next through eight light, through sixteen dark, through twenty light, through twenty-four void, through twenty-nine light, final degree void.
qualifications_and_limits: Endpoint language preserved in the raw table; exact continuous-boundary policy remains a declared implementation choice.

records.title: Pitted degrees and assistance
records.source_statement: Sun OR Ascendant degree OR Ascendant lord in a pitted degree describes the questioner at a stand and needing help, like a person unable to leave a ditch without assistance.
qualifications_and_limits: Sun is the checked glyph; do not substitute Moon by analogy. This does not certify a psychological state.

records.title: Azimene search starts from an observed condition
records.source_statement: If the person is observed impaired or chronically diseased, and the figure yields no immediate explanation, inspect Ascendant, Moon, Ascendant lord or principal lord in deficient degrees.
prerequisites: The impairment is already observed; the source proposes explanatory search.
qualifications_and_limits: This is retrospective selection, not a frozen forward test. Preserve the direction of inference and do not use for clinical advice.

records.title: Fortune-increasing degrees
records.source_statement: Second-house cusp OR second-house lord OR Jupiter OR Lot of Fortune in these degrees is an argument of wealth.
qualifications_and_limits: The text names the fifth column; the fortune column is sixth when counting the sign column. No empirical wealth probability follows.

records.title: Attributed Hermes rationale and topical use
records.source_statement: Lilly reports understanding the body table after reading Hermes aphorism 88: affliction concerns the part assigned to the afflicted sign. In a sickness question find the sick person's significator, its sign, and the corresponding part; Saturn in Gemini is the example of belly or heart.
qualifications_and_limits: Hermes attribution is reported through Lilly, not independently verified from a Hermes edition; not clinical guidance.

records.title: Domicile-relative anatomical sequence
records.source_statement: Planet in own sign governs head, second sign neck, third arms/shoulders, and so successively. Saturn Capricorn/Aquarius/Pisces and Jupiter Sagittarius/Capricorn/Aquarius illustrate the first three positions.
qualifications_and_limits: Multiple domiciles and extra table entries are not all derived by this short rationale. Do not overwrite the actual table.

records.title: Moon Aries explanation and counting tension
records.source_statement: Moon in Aries is assigned head because of Aries and knees because Aries is called the ninth sign from Cancer.
qualifications_and_limits: Forward offset is nine signs but inclusive ordinal place is tenth. Preserve source wording and both quantities instead of silently correcting the author.

records.title: Severity and proximity
records.source_statement: More sign affliction, or proximity to azimene/pitted/deficient degrees, is said to increase the mark, scar or infirmity.
qualifications_and_limits: No radius or quantitative dose-response is specified; historical assertion, not a clinical risk scale.

records.title: Radicality alternatives
records.source_statement: The hour lord and Ascendant lord are of one triplicity, are the same planet, OR are of the same nature. Examples: Mars hour with a water sign rising; Mars hour with Aries rising; Mars hour with Leo rising, Mars and Sun both hot and dry.
prerequisites: Horary question at its proposal time.
qualifications_and_limits: The triplicity wording and example need explicit implementation; not an automatic natal-chart exclusion rule.

records.title: Early Ascendant caution and exception
records.source_statement: At rising degrees 0, 1 or 2, especially short-ascension signs Capricorn through Gemini, avoid judgement unless the querent is very young AND body, complexion, moles/scars agree with the rising sign.
qualifications_and_limits: Degree-label boundaries and very young threshold are not specified; bodily agreement is historical interpretive evidence, not verified diagnostic information.

records.title: Late Ascendant caution and exceptions
records.source_statement: At rising degrees 27,28,29 judgement is unsafe, except when the querent's age corresponds to the degrees OR the figure uses a certain event time rather than a propounded question.
qualifications_and_limits: Do not apply the horary refusal automatically to a timed event or natal chart; exact continuous boundaries remain a declared policy.

records.title: Late Moon and attributed via-combusta caution
records.source_statement: Caution with Moon in late degrees, especially Gemini, Scorpio or Capricorn; some also warn of the last fifteen Libra or first fifteen Scorpio degrees, the via combusta.
qualifications_and_limits: No late-degree threshold here. The via-combusta addition is attributed to some, not silently made Lilly's categorical universal rule.

records.title: Void-of-course qualifications
records.source_statement: Matters proceed hardly when the Moon is void of course, EXCEPT if principal significators are very strong; she nevertheless performs somewhat in Taurus, Cancer, Sagittarius or Pisces.
qualifications_and_limits: These exceptions concern the judgement, not a redefinition of the motion state. They are not a promise that every desired event occurs.

records.title: Seventh-house artist caution, topic restriction
records.source_statement: Afflicted seventh cusp or retrograde/impeded seventh lord suggests the astrologer's judgement will give little content, when the matter belongs to another house and NOT the seventh.
qualifications_and_limits: Do not erase the topical exception, or equate querent satisfaction with predictive accuracy.

records.title: Saturn rising caution
records.source_statement: Saturn in the Ascendant, especially retrograde: the matter seldom or never comes to good.
prerequisites: Reported among Arabian rules, Alkindus and others.
qualifications_and_limits: Horary pre-judgement context; historical prescriptions, not an empirically calibrated abstention rule.

records.title: Saturn seventh alternatives
records.source_statement: Saturn seventh either corrupts the astrologer's judgement OR signifies a sequence of misfortunes.
prerequisites: Reported among Arabian rules, Alkindus and others.
qualifications_and_limits: Horary pre-judgement context; historical prescriptions, not an empirically calibrated abstention rule.

records.title: Combust Ascendant lord caution
records.source_statement: Combust Ascendant lord: the question will not take or the querent be regulated.
prerequisites: Reported among Arabian rules, Alkindus and others.
qualifications_and_limits: Horary pre-judgement context; historical prescriptions, not an empirically calibrated abstention rule.

records.title: Seventh lord impaired
records.source_statement: Unfortunate seventh lord, in fall or malefic terms: astrologer scarcely gives solid judgement.
prerequisites: Reported among Arabian rules, Alkindus and others.
qualifications_and_limits: Horary pre-judgement context; historical prescriptions, not an empirically calibrated abstention rule.

records.title: Equal testimony requires deferral
records.source_statement: With equal fortunate and unfortunate testimony, defer opinion until a better-informing question; the balance cannot be known.
prerequisites: Reported among Arabian rules, Alkindus and others.
qualifications_and_limits: Horary pre-judgement context; historical prescriptions, not an empirically calibrated abstention rule.

records.title: Querent, quesited and significator
records.source_statement: Querent asks; quesited is the person or thing sought. The topic's house ruler signifies its matter; rising sign and its ruler always belong to the asker.
qualifications_and_limits: Actor/subject roles matter; an identical planetary arrangement cannot be interpreted without the actual question.

records.title: Querent appearance and conditions are synthesized
records.source_statement: Rising sign contributes bodily form. Conditions mix its lord, the Moon, the planet in the Ascendant, and planets aspecting the Moon or Ascendant lord.
qualifications_and_limits: Equally mixed is source wording, not a fully specified numerical weighting or a licence to count one observation repeatedly.

records.title: Topic-first chain and represented helpers
records.source_statement: Identify the house appropriate to the matter, its sign/ruler, ruler's place and dignity, relation to Ascendant lord, helpers and impediments, and their house positions/rulerships. These identify the relations of assisting or hindering people.
qualifications_and_limits: Do not substitute a generic strongest planet for a topic-qualified significator.

records.title: Moon cosignificator and rejected extension
records.source_statement: Moon is cosignificator with querent/Ascendant lord in every question. Lilly expressly disapproves adding the planet from which the Moon separated as another querent significator, reporting no truth found in his practice.
qualifications_and_limits: The rejection concerns this automatic role assignment, not every use of separation. Author experience is development testimony.

records.title: Reported applying-planet quesited extension
records.source_statement: Others similarly joined the planet to which the Moon applied with the lord of the quesited house.
qualifications_and_limits: Reported practice; the preceding explicit rejection must not be mechanically expanded to this separate sentence or rewritten as endorsement.

records.title: Separate judgement questions
records.source_statement: After positions, applications, separations and aspects are considered, ask whether the matter occurs, by whose means, when, AND whether proceeding is good for the querent.
qualifications_and_limits: Occurrence, mechanism, timing and benefit are distinct outputs.

records.title: Perfection route organisation
records.source_statement: The chapter announces four means and discusses conjunction, aspect routes, translation and collection, followed by a qualified ancient house-dwelling rule.
qualifications_and_limits: Preserve headings and ensuing qualifications rather than use the count to discard a later clause.

records.title: Conjunction perfection and angularity
records.source_statement: Ascendant lord and topic lord hasten to conjunction in the first house or an angle without prohibition or refranation before perfection: the thing comes to pass without hindrance. Speed and essential or accidental strength hasten it; succedent placement delays, cadent brings much delay, difficulty and struggle.
prerequisites: Relevant principal significators.
No intervention or reversal before the promised encounter.
qualifications_and_limits: No numerical duration supplied; cadent is difficulty/delay, not automatic impossibility.

records.title: Sextile/trine perfection prerequisites
records.source_statement: Principals apply by sextile or trine from good houses with essential dignity and no malefic aspect intervening before the partile aspect.
qualifications_and_limits: An applying trine alone does not satisfy all conditions. Exact good-house/strength qualification needs an explicit source profile.

records.title: Square perfection prerequisites
records.source_statement: An applying square perfects provided EACH planet has dignity in its occupied degrees and they apply from proper good houses; otherwise not.
qualifications_and_limits: Do not reduce to square always prevents completion. The relevant degree convention must be explicit.

records.title: Opposition perfection, occurrence versus benefit
records.source_statement: Sometimes perfected by opposition when there is mutual reception by domicile, friendly houses, and Moon separates from the quesited significator and presently applies to the Ascendant lord. Lilly rarely sees perfection this way without the querent better off had it not happened.
prerequisites: Mutual reception by HOUSE, friendly houses, directed Moon transfer.
qualifications_and_limits: Retain the tension with XIX's broad easy-reception assertion; no retrospective preferred rule.

records.title: Opposition regret examples

source_statement.marriage: Perfection can coexist with continual quarrelling and blame for the choice.
source_statement.money: A promised debt/portion is obtained, but legal costs exceed its value.

qualifications_and_limits: Examples separate event attainment from net benefit; not relationship-safety or financial advice.

records.title: Translation perfection prerequisites
records.source_statement: Principals have separated from conjunction, sextile or trine. A third planet separates from one who receives it by domicile, triplicity OR term, then applies to the other before meeting ANY other conjunction or aspect.
prerequisites: Reception direction is source principal receiving intermediary.
No intervening encounter.
qualifications_and_limits: Do not silently add face/exaltation to this locally enumerated list or omit reception by borrowing the shorter XIX definition.

records.title: Translation identifies practical mediator
records.source_statement: The translating planet or its represented person brings the matter to perfection; its house rulership identifies means: second lord a purse, third lord kin or neighbour.
qualifications_and_limits: The intermediary's role is not another independent natal character score.

records.title: Collection prerequisites and direction
records.source_statement: Principals do not behold each other; both cast aspects to a planet heavier than both; BOTH PRINCIPALS RECEIVE THAT COLLECTOR in their essential dignities. The common mediator completes what they cannot arrange themselves.
qualifications_and_limits: Do not silently reverse to collector receives principals. Actual application/event order and mixed dignity cases need specified conventions.

records.title: House dwelling alone rejected
records.source_statement: Ancients infer attainment when topic significator dwells in Ascendant, such as tenth lord for an office. Lilly rejects this alone unless the Moon also transfers the desired matter's light to the Ascendant lord.
qualifications_and_limits: Retain rejected claim as attributed/rejected, not an extra positive rule.

records.title: Application inclination versus separation privation
records.source_statement: Applying principals show willingness and continued negotiation/probability of perfection; separation generally deprivation/little hope, notwithstanding favourable dwelling.
qualifications_and_limits: Inclination or further treaty is not identical to accomplished outcome; translation/collection routes retain their own prerequisites.

records.title: Querent house topics
qualifications_and_limits: No event or clinical inference from the mapping alone.

records.title: Seventh-house subject turned topics
qualifications_and_limits: Relative tenth is called mother in this example, whereas radical tenth above is esteem/honour. Do not assume all semantic labels rotate identically.

records.title: General turning and role-dependent origin
records.source_statement: Subject house becomes first and following houses second etc. Minister or wife's brother uses ninth; king asked about tenth. But a king AS ASKER uses the Ascendant, and nativities use the native's Ascendant, king or beggar.
qualifications_and_limits: Do not turn every royal natal chart from the tenth. Relative indices and ordinal counts must be explicit.

records.title: End of introduction and postponed Fortune calculation
records.source_statement: Learning is to recognise error and when to judge, not memorize every word. Fortune calculation is postponed to the first example, with author criticism of its treatment elsewhere.
qualifications_and_limits: Do not import a Fortune formula and attribute it to this passage; Book II examples remain unread.
